name: Military Base Tycoon [SAVES PROGRESS]
desc:
Build up your Military Base! A classic Tycoon: gain in-game Cash with Droppers, eliminating Soldiers🔫, collecting Cash Crates💵 and achieving Milestones! ⚔️And fight with other players⚔️, or team up🏳️! Don't worry about leaving, your progress saves!

If you enjoy the game, please leave a LIKE!👍

Annoyed of people oofing you or experiencing lag? Use the FREE Private Server!

Don't forget to check my group👪, Legacy Tycooning at: https://www.roblox.com/groups/12656581/Legacy-Tycooning. If you join this group you receive a bonus💰 $ 1 000 in-game once every Rebirth and a free Dropper on the second floor of your Tycoon!

Premium benefits: get a bonus💰 $ 2 000 once every Rebirth and a regenerating Coin which gives free Cash in-game periodically!

Patch Notes🛠️: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/military-base-tycoon-patch-notes

Again, you can really help me out by leaving a LIKE👍 and drop a FAVORITE⭐ if you had fun playing the game! Thank you for playing!
